5536.title: Idle provider cleanup and repeated-resume checks
5536.rootCauseOneLine: Not established; repeated worker reap/resume and focused Claude shutdown checks pass on trusted main.
5536.proposedFix: First reproduce with real Claude processes on isolated macOS and capture process-group and attachment ownership through reap/resume.
5536.caveats: Linux runtime tests use the scripted provider fixture; Claude bridge tests mock the external SDK. No real Claude process tree, production data, or duplicate actions tested. Five unrelated broad Claude baseline tests failed; relevant focused tests passed twice.
